summary: AlembicCore P6 lifecycle deadline repair completed on main at commit 9db27ba4201b8be53ea629e79c8edb0cf91e9597. Root cause: KnowledgeService creation could write stagingDeadline to DB, but file-first persistence omitted stagingDeadline from KnowledgeEntry wire/frontmatter and KnowledgeSyncService upsert omitted the staging_deadline DB column, so later file sync could clear deadlines for auto-approvable staging Recipes. Fixed Core persistence/sync contract so stagingDeadline is serialized, parsed, and upserted to knowledge_entries.staging_deadline. Added real SQLite integration coverage proving host-agent high-confidence Recipe creation writes non-empty staging_deadline, KnowledgeSyncService preserves it, and due staging entries promote to active through StagingManager/LifecycleStateMachine with lifecycle_transition_events recorded.
